<h3>Presumptive Laws Dashboard</h3><span class="tag tag--wip">under construction</span>

A state-by-state legislative history of first responder presumptive workers' compensation laws: which conditions are presumed work-related, for whom, and since when. Statute text is traced to primary sources rather than advocacy summaries. Built so that researchers and practitioners can see fifty scattered statutes in one place.

<div class="stack">R · Quarto · Shiny <a href="https://github.com/ALERRT-Research/PROJ_presumptive_laws">{{< fa brands github >}} source</a></div>
